{{Quote|"A place for [[Ooblets]] to hang out and help maintain your farm. [[Ooblets]] will perform tasks and speed up growth of your crops!"|[[Grumboire]]}} The Oobcoop is a building that allows your [[Ooblets]] to help you with farming by watering, removing obstacles such as twigs/hollow logs, rocks and weeds and providing a boost to crop growth speed. Each Oobcoop will increase the maximum number of [[Ooblets]] you can have on your farm (the number shown as "Home Buddies" in the [[Grumboire]]). The limit is increased by a number equal to the number of Ooblets that Oobcoop can hold. For example, a level 1 Oobcoop increases the limit by 1, and a level 5 Oobcoop increases the limit by 5. == Obtaining == In order to obtain an Oobcoop, you can go to the [[Manatwee]] furniture shop and produce a Level 1 Oobcoop using the [[Fabricuter]]. To further upgrade the Oobcoop, the player must purchase the next level's recipe from the [[Wishy Well]] for 100 [[wishies]], place the Oobcoop on the farm, enter it, and select the option to upgrade it (ensuring you have enough of the required resources). Leveling the Oobcoop must be in subsequent order from level 1 to 5. == Oobcoop Levels==
